Intro: How I've kept you in anticipation! My further research has led to some interesting results indeed. Listen closely, I do not wish others to overhear.
I have discovered Spoilage is not contagious and its progression can be halted if the patient is relieved of their mental turmoil. There's more but…
The answer lies within this city. Rumor is there is a pale man who is seeking something here. People speak of this Spoiled's ability to reveal truths.
However, all who share their encounter shortly disappear after. Whether this is the government's cover up or the pale man's doing I do not know.
If you were to ever meet this person, will you divulge any information to me about him? I intend to meet him myself to learn about the Spoilage.
Success: Thank you, you are the only one I can trust with this information.
Fail: It's getting worse…? I'm sorry, it seems my taste has been off lately.
Reject: You fear to learn the truth? I did not take you as someone content with simple-minded ignorance, chef.
